purpose: Contextual terminology independently assessed by actual FINAL729 against Arabic and complete selected sources; no human/native/scholarly certification.

entries.Chinese: 阿哈德（独一无二）/瓦希德（唯一）
entries.scope: Only lexical transliterations needed to distinguish two Arabic unity words; normal explanation in Chinese. Quran wording unchanged.

entries.Chinese: 万物所仰赖的主；自身无求、属性全美、众生在需要中奔向他
entries.scope: All three reported meanings, not confined to one gloss. Chinese quote112:2 always exact publisher.
Both independent subsistence and sustaining all, not simply wisdom.
Source divine-name context: no injustice or broken promise, not a human believer.

entries.Chinese: 温厚而细致的眷顾、施恩精微
entries.scope: Living meaning in Yusuf story; exact67:14玄妙publisher wording remains distinct.

entries.Chinese: 未见之事；经文中保留幽玄
entries.scope: No claim means only current human ignorance.
Retreating/withdrawing whisperer, not merely a hidden human.

entries.Chinese: 无子嗣、非由他者所生；引文生产在此指生育
entries.scope: Own explanation distinguishes creation from begetting, no scripture rewrite.
Reported conditional lexical proposal, no certain derivation or likeness.

entries.Chinese: 自己为之付出的事在心中的分量
entries.scope: Contextual importance/value planted by action; not an unsupported strict mathematical relation between amount spent and esteem.
